en.title: Downloading E-Tickets and Venue Check-in QR Codes
en.excerpt: How archers access electronic tickets, verify registration credentials, and present check-in QR codes for field equipment inspection.
en.content:
Accessing Electronic Tickets

Once your tournament registration status is marked Paid or Verified, your electronic ticket is generated automatically under Archer Dashboard > My Events > E-Ticket.

Credential Information on Tickets

The digital ticket contains all critical event participation credentials:

  • Athlete Identity: Full name, registered club name, and category division.
  • Participant ID & Target Assignment: Your assigned target butt and shooting wave (e.g., Target 12B - Session 1).
  • Tamper-Proof QR Code: Unique scannable code linked to your verified registration record.

Venue Check-in & Equipment Inspection

Present your e-ticket on your mobile device (or a printed copy) at the tournament registration desk. Field officials scan the QR code to verify attendance and mark your equipment inspection checklist.
